executiveSummary: Critical unauthenticated RCE risk in Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA refrigeration/HVAC controllers via crafted HTTP POST; CISA urges removal of internet exposure, Strict Mode, and upgrade planning to 5.5.x. Potential cold-chain disruption and lateral OT risk. Security Advisory CISA added Danfoss AK-SM 800A and other edge platforms (Juniper Session Smart, Mitel MiCollab, Xen Orchestra) to KEV for active exploitation-accelerate patching and compromise checks. CISA KEV Active exploitation of GeoServer RCE chains observed in the wild; municipal/utility GIS servers are at risk-patch to 2.27.7/2.28.6/3.0.2 and restrict access. View Article Node-RED RCE (CVE-2026-58115) attempts reported against instances with exposed editor/admin API and no adminAuth-material risk to IIoT/OT gateways; lock down immediately. Supporting Report Advantech industrial gateways: multiple unauthenticated RCE/critical-function bypasses enable remote takeover of OT connectivity-immediately restrict TCP/5058 and segment. CISA Bulletin Nation-state pre-positioning continues: China-nexus covert SOHO/IoT networks and router abuse, and Russian FSB Center 16 campaigns against weakly managed routers increase enterprise-to-OT pivot risk. Advisory Advisory Ransomware pressure persists with sector-relevant TTPs: StopRansomware advisories on SafePay and Gunra highlight VPN exploits, LOTL, cloud exfiltration, and rapid mass-encryption; harden remote access and backups. CISA Advisory CISA Advisory Siemens S7 PLC targeting: joint advisory details AI-assisted scripts abusing S7comm (TCP/102) against exposed/poorly segmented PLCs. Prioritize S7 hardening and ICS segmentation. CISA Advisory Enterprise perimeter risk with OT implications: Palo Alto PAN-OS devices targeted via chained PHP2Shell + kernel LPE; restrict management plane to jump hosts and patch urgently. View Article

kpis.label: Current OT Threat Level
kpis.trend: Driven by active KEV items and OT controller RCE

relevance: This cycle features multiple direct OT controller and gateway issues (Danfoss AK-SM, Advantech EKI, Node-RED in IIoT stacks) plus management-plane and virtual infrastructure risks (Juniper Session Smart, VMware vCenter/ESXi, PAN-OS) frequently used to host, broker, or protect access to industrial systems. Active exploitation items in CISA's KEV catalog and field reports on GeoServer and Node-RED elevate the likelihood of IT-to-OT pivots if segmentation and access controls are weak. Threat Actor Activity China-nexus covert SOHO/IoT networks leveraged for stealthy pre-positioning in CNI; harden edge devices and monitor egress. CISA Advisory Russian FSB Center 16 campaigns against routers via SNMP defaults, Cisco SMI, and known CVEs-tighten router hygiene and monitoring. CISA Advisory SafePay ransomware: credential abuse, PsExec/WinRM, cloud exfiltration; 600+ victims across sectors since 2024. StopRansomware Gunra ransomware: Fortinet VPN/device exploits, AD theft, M365 exfiltration; cross-platform variant noted. StopRansomware PAN-OS perimeter exploitation via chained PHP2Shell + kernel LPE; suspected China-nexus actor. View Article Vulnerability and CVE Watch Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA critical stack overflow (CVE-2026-129713) and KEV entries for AK-SM 800A-treat as active risk. Security Advisory Eclipse Milo (OPC UA server) multiple auth/DoS issues threaten industrial data flows. CISA Bulletin Siemens Industrial Edge "NGINX2Root" and related RCEs-apply Siemens mitigations/workarounds. Vendor Summary Drupal Fail2Install (CVE-2026-132165) actively exploited-secure install endpoints and update immediately. View Article AutomationDirect C-More EA9 Programming Software heap overflow (V6.80)-update to V6.81. Security Advisory OpenPLC Runtime auth-bypass user creation-update to ≥4.3.0 and restrict runtime interfaces. Security Advisory Affected Vendors & Technologies Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA / 800A (HVAC/refrigeration controllers) Siemens S7-1200/1500 PLCs, TIA Portal/STEP 7 Advantech EKI industrial gateways (edgserver TCP/5058) Node-RED (IIoT orchestration), GeoServer (GIS), OPC UA (Eclipse Milo) Juniper Session Smart (Conductor/Router), Mitel MiCollab, Vates Xen Orchestra VMware vCenter/ESXi estates, Palo Alto PAN-OS firewalls AutomationDirect C-More EA9, Autonomy Logic OpenPLC Affected Sectors Commercial Facilities (retail refrigeration/HVAC), Food & Agriculture (cold-chain) Water & Wastewater Systems, Energy, Critical Manufacturing Government Services and Facilities (GIS/web platforms) Transportation (industrial controls, geospatial services)

descriptions: Initial Access via public-facing apps and device exploits (ATT&CK T1190), including controller/gateway web handlers and VPN appliances.
Living-off-the-Land lateral movement (PsExec, WMI, WinRM) and credential access (LSASS dumping), with cloud exfiltration (rclone/OneDrive) in ransomware cases (T1021, T1003, TA0010).
Abuse of OT protocols/services: S7comm on TCP/102, OPC UA method/monitored items misuse; Node-RED flow injection to execute OS commands.
Supply-chain and virtual infrastructure pivoting via vCenter/ESXi admin APIs and PAN-OS management planes.

outlook72h: Prioritize emergency exposure reduction for Danfoss AK-SM and Node-RED endpoints; schedule maintenance windows to apply mitigations and logging enhancements. Deploy targeted hunts for GeoServer stored query abuse, Node-RED flow changes, and anomalous traffic to WFS/OWS and TCP/1880/5058/102. Fast-track KEV remediation for Juniper Session Smart and MiCollab; validate no pre-patch persistence or new admin accounts. Increase watch on virtualization estates (vCenter/ESXi) and PAN-OS management for unusual admin sessions or Host Profile changes.
